title: Luísa Sonza Makes Her Tomorrowland Belgium Debut, Joining Kris Kross Amsterdam for ‘My Oh My’
summary: The singer joined the Dutch duo during their Tomorrowland set.
contentText:
Luísa Sonza made her debut on the Tomorrowland Belgium stage Friday (July 24), joining the set of Dutch duo Kris Kross Amsterdam to perform — live for the first time — their track “My Oh My,” released in partnership with French singer and producer Willy William.

The appearance took place on The Great Library stage, one of the festival’s main stages, at 5 p.m. local time, with Sonza popping up as a guest during the duo’s electronic music set.

The collaboration was born after a meeting between Kris Kross Amsterdam and Willy William backstage at the Q Music Awards. Looking for a voice to complete the track, the DJs invited Luísa, who brought her pop identity to the production.

“I’m very excited and honored to represent Brazilian pop at a festival that brings together people from more than 200 countries,” the singer tells Billboard Brazil .

View this post on Instagram

“My Oh My” isn’t the singer’s first collaboration with foreign artists: Luísa has previously shared tracks with names including PRETTYMUCH, Danna Paola, Aitana and Katy Perry, expanding her presence outside Brazil.
